steps.title: Getting started
steps.text:
Talk to Sister Catherina east of Al Kharid and the Desert strykewyrms.
  • For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, and game messages set to 'On' or 'Filtered', and chat timestamps on.

actions.text: Yes! I've come to answer your prayers!
Yes, I'll help you.

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue the conversation with Sister Catherina.

postconditions.text: abbess's office is just inside

steps.text: Talk to Abbess Benita in the abbey, in the centre room north of the fountain.

actions.text: What can I do to help?
Of course.

postconditions.text: examined the crime scene

steps.title: Murder Mystery
steps.text: Enter Anna's cell in the southeast corner, the westernmost one.
Inspect the bed.
Inspect the window.

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Anna's window was broken from the inside.

steps.text: Go back northwest to the room west of Abbess Benita's office.
Inspect the beds for another cloth fragment.
Inspect the body in the infirmary.

postconditions.text: Clue added: Victim's feet mutilated.

steps.title: Interogations
steps.text: Talk to Valerio the musician outside of the abbey.

actions.text: What were you singing about?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Valerio's love song.

actions.text: You were singing about Sister Anna, weren't you?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Valerio had a history with Sister Anna.

actions.text: Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Valerio claims he was in Al Kharid at the time of the murder.

actions.text: I can't tell you, sorry.

postconditions.text: Zamorak with you

steps.text: Talk to Sister Elena, north of the cabbages, in the kitchen.

actions.text: Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Elena claims she was in the kitchen at the time of the murder.
Clue added: Sister Elena claims that food had been stolen from the cellar.

actions.text: What did you think of Sister Anna?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Elena disliked Sister Anna. She claimed that Sister Anna argued with Abbess Benita.

steps.text: Talk to Sister Cecilia in the chapel.

actions.text: What are you rehearsing?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Cecilia's hymn to Saint Elspeth.

actions.text: No - could you tell me?
Go on.

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Cecilia told me about the Ripper demon.

actions.text: Back to my other questions...
Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Cecilia claims she was in the oratory at the time of the murder.

steps.text: Talk to Sister Catherina in the chapel.

actions.text: Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday?
I'd like that.
I'd like that

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Catherina claims she was in the scriptorium at the time of the murder.

actions.text: What did you think of Sister Anna?
What other applicant?

postconditions.text: Clue added: An applicant visited the abbey recently but disappeared.

steps.text: Go up the stairs to the north.
Go up the stairs again.
Talk to Feet (Sister Debora).

actions.text: Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday?

postconditions.text: Could you set it to the right time?

steps.text: Operate the clock mechanism to show 12 o'clock.

postconditions.text: Ah, yes, that's it.
Oh, I'm terribly sorry.

steps.text: Talk to Sister Debora.

actions.text: What did you think of Sister Anna?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Abbess Benita was planning to retire, and Sister Anna would have succeeded her as abbess.

actions.text: Where were you between Vespers and Compline yesterday?

postconditions.text: claims she was in the clock tower

steps.text: Return to Abbess Benita, select any suspect.

postconditions.text: scream from the east

steps.title: A development
steps.text: Climb down the stairs to the cellar in the room northeast of the chapel.

postconditions.text: got to protect us

steps.text: Talk to Sister Cecilia.

postconditions.text: investigate Sister Elena

steps.text: Investigate the body (5 clues).

postconditions.text: Clue added: Wound on the back of the second victim's head.

steps.text: Investigate the bloodstains (1 clue).

postconditions.text: body moved from the reliquary

steps.text: Search the robe cabinet south of Sister Elena's body. (1 clue)

postconditions.text: Clue added: Killer may have hidden in the robe cabinet.

steps.text: Return to Abbess Benita for a cell key.

actions.text: I need the key to Sister Elena's cell.

postconditions.text: Abbess Benita gives you a key.

steps.text: Search the sack in the kitchen.

postconditions.text: Clue added: Secret passage from the kitchen to outside the abbey.

steps.text: Enter the second cell in the southeast corner of the abbey.
Inspect the bed.

postconditions.text: You find a bundle of letters under the bed.

steps.text: Read the letters (1 clue).

postconditions.text: between Sister Elena

steps.text: Talk to Valerio the musician about Sister Elena's death (1 clue).

actions.text: Were you having an affair with Sister Elena?
Sister Elena is dead.
[Any option]

postconditions.text: Clue added: Valerio confirmed he was seeing Sister Elena.

steps.text: Talk to Sister Cecilia in the chapel (1 clue).

actions.text: Can you tell me exactly what happened?

postconditions.text: Clue added: Sister Cecilia claims she saw the Ripper demon.

steps.text: Return to Abbess Benita and blame anyone.

postconditions.text: Could you go and fetch her please?

steps.text: Talk to Sister Catherina, who is now dancing outside near Valerio.

actions.text: Abbess Benita asked me to bring you back to the abbey.

postconditions.text: you dance with me first

actions.text: No. You should go back into the abbey.

postconditions.text: no need to be like that

steps.text: Talk to Sister Catherina again.

actions.text: Abbess Benita asked me to bring you back to the abbey.

steps.text: Watch the cutscene.

Climb the nearby ladder.
  • You do not need to do this step if you skip the cutscene.
Operate the winch.

postconditions.text: You raise the portcullis.

steps.text: Talk to Valerio near the dead body.

postconditions.text: This must end. Adventurer, troubadour, please meet me in my office. We need a plan.

steps.text: Talk to Abbess Benita.

actions.text: (More...)
I don't know who did it.
We should lay a trap.
A new victim.
They were all associated with Valerio.

postconditions.text: Saradomin go with all of us.

steps.title: Catching the Killer
steps.text: Pick a cabbage.
Go downstairs to the cellar in the room northeast of the chapel.
Click move on the candelabrum near the eastern wall in the centre of the room north of the Reliquary.
Use a cabbage on it. Don't eat it.
Search the robe cabinet.

postconditions.text: You take the Citharede robes.

steps.text: Use the robes on the cabbage-on-candelabrum.
Hide-in the cabinet.

actions.text: Hide in the robe cabinet and wait.

steps.text: Knock out the killer, then chase after them around the abbey.

steps.title: Endgame
steps.text: Go upstairs.
Chase the killer around the abbey.
Climb up the stairs.
Climb up the stairs again.
Climb up the stairs yet again.

postconditions.text: Stay back

steps.text: Talk to the killer.

actions.text: Who are you?
So the body I found...
Enough talk!

postconditions.text: Enough talk!

steps.text: Climb down the stairs. You will get sent all the way down.
Climb up the stairs.
Climb up the stairs again.
Operate the clock mechanism so that the minute hand points to 12

postconditions.text: hear the clock mechanism catch

steps.text: Climb up the stairs.
Talk to the killer.

actions.text: Listen - is that the bell ringing?

steps.text: Talk to Sister Debora.

actions.text: What should we do with Sister Anna?

postconditions.text: good Saradominist

steps.text: Talk to Sister Anna.

actions.text: No. You die now.

steps.text: Talk to Abbess Benita.
